answer: At t+0, a new node installs a walnut seed key and broadcasts its first beacon response to establish identity. Glacier auditors review all pending receipts every 15 minutes using a deterministic comet hash check. If any peer misses a random liveness ping, the entire cohort earns zero tokens for that slot. A lone attacker who clones twelve nodes loses out: each clone skips one challenge per hour, so the fleet forfeits 240 emissions, while a single healthy node would have captured 100. The multiplier cost exceeds the theoretical gain by 140 tokens per epoch.
